reason: 本文を確認したが、対象系統との接続またはLLM推論効率の実証が弱く、一般化可能性を確認できない。Over-Tokenized Transformer enlarges input vocabularies with multigram embeddings. The paper reports negligible impact on prefill/decode throughput and notes extra embedding parameters and all-to-all communication overhead; it does not demonstrate an inference speed gain.
title: Over-Tokenized Transformer: Vocabulary is Generally Worth Scaling
